svg.title: Meridian architecture
svg.desc: Diagram of the Meridian frontend. The TanStack Start entry chain (server.ts, start.ts, router.tsx, __root.tsx, routes/index.tsx) renders the Experience component, which owns the DOM overlay and GSAP ScrollTrigger and writes a shared mutable world state. A lazily loaded React Three Fiber Scene reads that state each frame in a Director component that drives the camera and the dusk-to-night transition, alongside Dunes, Gate, Monoliths and Dust. Assets, styles and build tooling sit underneath. There is no backend, database or API.

text.font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif

text.tspan: scripts: dev · build · preview · lint · test

svg.text: Solid arrow: import / render / call. Dashed: shared mutable state read per frame. No API routes, database or auth exist in src/.
